title: Broncos activate WR Pat Bryant from the IR and place DL Eyioma Uwazurike on the IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos activate WR Pat Bryant from the IR and place DL Eyioma Uwazurike on the IR
sources.description: The Denver Broncos announced today that they have activated wide receiver Pat Bryant from the injured reserve to the active roster and also placed defensive lineman Eyioma Uwazurike on the injured reserve with a shoulder injury. The team also announced it signed reserve cornerback Sam Fresch Jr. from the practice squad to the active roster. […]
